deals.travelWindow: Jan, Allegiant nonstop; $52 one-way Jan 10/23, $60 Jan 17, $69 Jan 24
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way from $52 (Jan 10/23), about $104–130 round trip; unchanged vs yesterday, Everglades 1 h away.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable Las Olas and Riverwalk, a water taxi network and cheap beach hostels make it easy alone.

highlights: Riverwalk and Las Olas Boulevard on foot
Fort Lauderdale Beach and the A1A promenade
Water Taxi along the Intracoastal
Everglades airboat or Shark Valley tram day trip
itinerary: Day 1 — Arrive FLL, A1A beach walk, sunset at Las Olas Beach
Day 2 — Everglades day: Anhinga Trail at Royal Palm, then Shark Valley tram
Day 3 — Hugh Taylor Birch State Park via Water Taxi, then Las Olas for a last dinner
guide.gettingAround: Airport is 3 miles from downtown; use Brightline/Tri-Rail, the Water Taxi and rideshare. Rent a car only for the Everglades day.
guide.stayArea: Beach area near Las Olas or downtown by the Riverwalk: walkable with hostels and budget hotels.

deals.travelWindow: Nov 14 – Dec 13, Allegiant nonstop; $56 one-way Nov 14 and Dec 13
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way from $56 (Nov 14, Dec 13), about $112–135 round trip; Great Smoky Mountains NP is an hour away.
deals.soloWhy: Compact Market Square and Old City are walkable and the Urban Wilderness trails are inside the city.

highlights: Market Square and Old City nights, plus the Sunsphere view
Sunsphere observation deck (free)
Urban Wilderness trails and Ijams Nature Center
Smokies day trip: Alum Cave or Laurel Falls
itinerary: Day 1 — Market Square, Sunsphere, Old City
Day 2 — Rental car to Great Smoky Mountains NP, Laurel Falls or Alum Cave Trail
Day 3 — Urban Wilderness loop or Ijams, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable, but you need a rental car for the Smokies.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square, for walkability and food.

deals.travelWindow: Dec – Mar, Allegiant nonstop; Mar 5 $73 one-way, Dec 11 $87, Dec 17 $95
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way from $73 (Mar 5) and $87 (Dec 11), about $160–185 round trip; Blue Ridge Parkway 15 min away.
deals.soloWhy: Compact, walkable downtown with a strong hostel and brewery scene plus easy trailheads near town.

highlights: Downtown and the River Arts District on foot
Blue Ridge Parkway overlooks, including Craggy Gardens
Biltmore Estate grounds
Brewery row on Wedge and Coxe Ave
itinerary: Day 1 — Downtown walk, River Arts District studios, dinner on Biltmore Ave
Day 2 — Rental car up the Parkway: Craggy Gardens Pinnacle
Day 3 — Biltmore grounds or Mount Pisgah views, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable but the Parkway and trailheads need a rental car; check Parkway closures for winter ice.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or Montford/South Slope for walkable food and breweries.

deals.travelWindow: Oct 29 – Nov, Allegiant nonstop; Nov 19 $80 one-way, Oct 29 $88, Nov 12 $96
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way from $80 (Nov 19), about $165–190 round trip; easy solo city, nearest big park area 2.5 h.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable downtown, a big craft-beer and museum scene, and a safe small city.

highlights: Frederik Meijer Gardens and Sculpture Park
Downtown brewery trail (Founders, Brewery Vivant)
Grand Rapids Art Museum
Lake Michigan dunes at Hoffmaster or Grand Haven
itinerary: Day 1 — Downtown, art museum, brewery evening
Day 2 — Meijer Gardens, then Grand Haven pier
Day 3 — Hoffmaster dunes boardwalk, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable and the DASH shuttle is free; rent a car for the lakeshore.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or Heritage Hill for walkability to breweries and museums.

deals.travelWindow: Now – Nov 18, JetBlue nonstop basic economy; $197 round trip on many dates
deals.whyRanked: JetBlue nonstop round trip from $197 (basic economy; an Alaska $179 listing also circulates); fare window closes Nov 18.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable neighborhoods, trolley and bus links, hostels in the Gaslamp and Pacific Beach, safe beach paths.

highlights: Torrey Pines coastal trails
La Jolla Cove sea lions and kayaking
Balboa Park museums and gardens
Point Loma tide pools at Cabrillo
itinerary: Day 1 — Balboa Park, then Gaslamp dinner
Day 2 — Torrey Pines Beach Trail, La Jolla Cove, tacos in Pacific Beach
Day 3 — Cabrillo tide pools, Little Italy, fly home
guide.gettingAround: Trolley and buses cover downtown and Old Town; rideshare or a rental car helps for Torrey Pines and Point Loma.
guide.stayArea: Gaslamp or Little Italy for transit and food; Pacific Beach for a hostel and beach scene.
